mapper.select: SELECT ENTRY_ID, VOUCHER_ID, ENTRY_SEQ, SUBJECT_ID, DEBIT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, EXCHANGE_RATE, ORIGINAL_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_CREDIT, AUXILIARY_INFO, ENTRY_DESC, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY WHERE VOUCHER_ID = #{voucherId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ENTRY_SEQ ASC

SELECT ENTRY_ID, VOUCHER_ID, ENTRY_SEQ, SUBJECT_ID, DEBIT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, EXCHANGE_RATE, ORIGINAL_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_CREDIT, AUXILIARY_INFO, ENTRY_DESC, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT ENTRY_ID, VOUCHER_ID, ENTRY_SEQ, SUBJECT_ID, DEBIT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, EXCHANGE_RATE, ORIGINAL_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_CREDIT, AUXILIARY_INFO, ENTRY_DESC, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY WHERE ENTRY_ID = #{entryId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE T_VOUCHER_ENTRY SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATER = #{updater}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE VOUCHER_ID = #{voucherId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ( ENTRY_ID, VOUCHER_ID, ENTRY_SEQ, SUBJECT_ID, DEBIT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, EXCHANGE_RATE, ORIGINAL_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_CREDIT, AUXILIARY_INFO, ENTRY_DESC, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER ) VALUES ( #{entryId}, #{voucherId}, #{entrySeq}, #{subjectId}, #{debitAmount}, #{creditAmount}, #{currencyCode}, #{exchangeRate}, #{originalDebit}, #{originalCredit}, #{auxiliaryInfo}, #{entryDesc}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{creator}, #{updater} )
